method.client_cohort: producer start in [measurement_start, measurement_start+30s); late confirmations and receipts retained
method.db_cohort: DB start in fixed measured window; late completions retained
method.throughput: events with timestamps in [start,end), counted separately for starts, confirms and receipts
method.cpu: PID+creation-time matched endpoint deltas of the 12 persistent owned processes and worker inside sampled window; observed transient identities are disclosed separately and not included in these endpoint CPU deltas; not whole-stack/cgroup/exited-process accounting
method.rss: sum of sampled RSS double-counts shared pages, not unique physical memory
method.native: uncollected by design; no native operation joins/counts/timings/decomposition
method.checksum: client valid flags and exact run IDs verified; payload bytes are not retained, so audit cannot independently rehash transmitted payload
method.comparisons: only A versus B within this session; report eligibility per predeclared pair, retain invalid-pair observations descriptively; no absolute comparison to prior sessions

terminal.reason: G2 failed PG stability or drift gate
terminal.scope: Uninstrumented-native client-side confirmation only; native stages/traces uncollected by design. Client timing, ID/checksum accounting, psutil resource sampling and PostgreSQL I/O timing remain enabled. Volatile storage: /tmp tmpfs and workspace overlay fsync=volatile. Not SSD, durability, capacity, ERP, reliability or product performance qualification. CPU affinity only; no enforceable cgroup CPU quota, memory ceiling or swap limit. RSS sums double-count shared pages; CPU sums cover currently live owned processes.

mechanism_scope.B: Early bounded nonblocking write attempt before consumer SQL; shares per-turn write budget with the later readiness-driven attempt
mechanism_scope.unchanged: storage.c, SQL, seven cached plans, workload, policy and native trace scope
mechanism_scope.not_measured: Wire-level Accepted timing, native stage time, internal execution counts, exact send timing and mechanism causality are not measured

interpretation.native_mechanism_attribution: Not measured. No native traces or wire evidence; do not infer an Accepted frame was sent early or an internal timing saving occurred.
interpretation.qualification: Only bounded volatile-cloud, affinity-only observations; no SSD, ERP, durability, reliability, capacity, resource-ceiling or adoption qualification.
interpretation.decision: No adoption decision is made by this raw-results audit. Keep gate failures, unfavorable tails and CPU per observed delivery visible.
